HR, Talent & Executive Mobility

Build the right team in Saudi Arabia, and help your leaders relocate and settle with confidence.

Book a Consultation

Service overview

People are the heart of a successful entry

We help you plan your organisation, understand localisation requirements, recruit key talent and support the relocation of senior executives and their families.

Who it is for

Is this service right for you?

  • Companies building their first Saudi team
  • Businesses planning workforce localisation
  • Organisations relocating senior executives to the Kingdom
  • Leadership teams designing a Saudi operating structure

Common client challenges

Challenges we help you overcome

  • Understanding workforce localisation expectations
  • Attracting and retaining skilled talent in competitive sectors
  • Designing roles, grades and reward that fit local norms
  • Coordinating visas, residency and family relocation

Our scope

End-to-end support across your journey

Practical support across planning, hiring and relocation.

  • Organisation design and workforce planning
  • Localisation approach and role mapping
  • Executive and specialist search coordination
  • Compensation and benefits benchmarking
  • Visa, residency and relocation coordination
  • Onboarding and integration support

Key deliverables

What you will receive

  • Organisation and workforce plan

  • Localisation roadmap

  • Role profiles and reward benchmarks

  • Executive mobility plan

  • Onboarding programme outline

Our process

A structured path to delivery

  1. 1

    Plan

    We define the organisation you need and the roles to fill first.

  2. 2

    Source

    We coordinate search and assessment of key talent.

  3. 3

    Relocate

    We support visas, residency and settling in.

  4. 4

    Integrate

    We help teams onboard and align to your operating model.

Your responsibilities

How you can support

  • Provide required information and documentation

  • Timely review and approval of submissions

  • Engage in key meetings with relevant stakeholders

  • Share business objectives and operational plans

Frequently asked questions

FAQs

Do you handle recruitment directly?

We coordinate search and assessment, working with qualified recruitment partners where specialist reach is needed.

Can you advise on localisation requirements?

Yes. We outline what applies to your sector and size and help you plan a practical approach, confirming details with the relevant authorities.

Do you support families relocating?

We coordinate practical steps such as residency, schooling information and settling-in support.
